author: reek
body: Every case below is a shape that fails differently, and the failures are as load-bearing as the successes: an evaluator that answers a number for input it did not understand is the defect this whole chapter exists to avoid, so roughly half these cases require an error and say which.

author: reek
body: The precedence pair is the one to read first. `1 + 2 * 3` and `1 | 2 + 3` differ only in which operators they use, and they pin the two-level rule from opposite sides: 7 says multiplication binds tighter, and 6 says the or and the plus do not -- `(1 | 2) + 3`, where C would give 8 by binding the plus first.
